title: Memories of the Civil War and Spanish-American War
summary: Glass says he remembers the Civil War battle shooting around the French Quarter.

blocks.x: Do you remember the Spanish and American War? Yeah. Well, I remember the Civil War, too. What went on there? Shooting and gun on.
